title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Next-Business-Day Bank Transfer Fee: Scope, Quotation and Booking
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — the fee on a next-business-day transfer to a bank account.**

## Scope

The bank transfer fee schedule sets the bank transfer fee: the fee of the plan's latest transfer of the day, the transfer booked on the plan today with the highest daily sequence, when that transfer goes next business day to a bank account and the employer's fee model of the base fee rule leaves it payable by the worker. For such a fee, and only for such a fee, it replaces the base rule on the listed fee, and every other fee, the instant transfer fees among them, remains under the base rule.

## Quotation

The bank transfer fee is quoted to the worker with the transfer's amount, speed and destination for the worker's confirmation, and it is worked out for that transfer as confirmed, the transfer counted as booked today, so the figure quoted is the figure booked.

## When the fee is booked

The bank transfer fee is booked only after the next-business-day bank transfer it prices stands on the plan's ledger as today's latest transfer entry.

That is, the fee entry waits on the plan's ledger showing, as the transfer entry booked today with the highest daily sequence, the next-business-day transfer to a bank account that the fee prices.

## Booking the fee: `book_bank_transfer_fee_9f154276`

**Capability.** Books the fee owed on one next-business-day transfer to a bank account on a worker's Earned Wage Access Plan; a transfer of any other speed or destination is refused with an error and nothing is booked. One call books one fee entry that points to that transfer, carries the transfer's payday, delivery speed and destination, is typed as a next-business-day fee, and adds the fee to the plan's outstanding balance to be recovered on that payday; the delivered transfer amount is untouched. The worker sees the fee on the plan's history at once.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_bank_transfer_fee_9f154276` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `access_plan_id` | the reference number of the worker's Earned Wage Access Plan, read from the plan record looked up for this worker | identifier text |
| `related_entry_id` | the reference number of the plan's next-business-day transfer to a bank account the fee is owed on, read from the plan's ledger or from the confirmation the worker's transfer returned | identifier text |
| `amount` | the fee | US dollars, a positive figure with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent if more places are given |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence carrying the new fee entry's reference number, the fee booked in US dollars with two decimals, the transfer reference it points to, the payday it is recovered on (YYYY-MM-DD) and the plan's outstanding balance including the fee in US dollars with two decimals; the reference number's presence means the fee is booked. Explicit errors: an `amount` that is not a positive dollar figure; no plan with the given `access_plan_id`; a `related_entry_id` that is not a transfer entry on that plan; a transfer that is not a next-business-day transfer to a bank account. On an error no fee is booked.
